correctness.rationale: PASS: The roots alpha,beta of X²-PX-1 have product -1, and the discriminant Delta=P²+4 is nonsquare and positive for P>=3. At odd unramified primes let w=alpha/beta; p|V_n iff w^n=-1, which occurs exactly at odd multiples of the first trace-zero rank lambda. If w has order 2lambda, odd-power LTE gives nu_p(V_(lambda k))=nu_p(V_lambda)+nu_p(k) for odd k and zero valuations off that support. Möbius inversion then yields signed support only at lambda,2lambda,lambda p^j,2lambda p^j (with index-one collision treated separately), so the least repair is 2lambda/gcd(2lambda,p-1); at ramified odd primes both repeated roots are nonzero and trace never vanishes. Split Frobenius gives order 2lambda dividing p-1, so Dold holds, while inert Frobenius forces existence of a trace-zero rank precisely when p=3 mod4 and its least repair is lambda. At p=2, if P is odd the nonzero transform is T(1)=1,T(3)=3,T(6)=-2, giving repair 3; if P is even with v2(P)=s, T(1)=2^s,T(2)=2-2^s, giving repair 1 and positivity only when s=1. These combine with quadratic character independence modulo 4 and prime distribution in arithmetic progressions to give exactly density 1/4 for bad odd primes. Independently checked 8,316 local Dold congruence cells over seven parameters P in {3,4,5,6,7,10,13}, twelve primes<=37 and n<=99; all matched Legendre-class predictions. Exact spot transforms included P=3,p=7: T4=6,T8=-6,T28=42,T56=-42; P=3,p=2: T1=1,T3=3,T6=-2; and P=4,p=2: T1=4,T2=-2. This finite evidence supplements the infinite proof.
residual_risks: The Frobenius and odd-order rank argument must handle ramified primes and index-one collisions distinctly; these cases were checked rather than inferred from generic LTE.
Finite verification is not proof of infinitely many indices or Dirichlet/character density; these follow from the reconstructed theory.

That prior result is credited: its arguments and special-case statements are not novel here. Resultary related work covers split companion Lucas pairs and q=-1 period comparisons, not the full nonsplit local Dold law. Generalized Lucas valuations are established prior ingredients and might imply the new theorem with substantial adaptation; no inspected primary theorem explicitly covers all P>=3.

value.rationale: PASS: The question of local Dold integrality and nonnegative realizability for a whole natural companion-Lucas family is motivated by periodic-point counting, exact signed Möbius transforms, and arithmetic prime splitting. The uniform inert-prime criterion, sharp repair factors, exceptional binary branch and density 1/4 answer the exact structural problem across infinitely many P, rather than a small numerical parameter extension. Although the old P=1 case already has density 3/4, the varying-discriminant full family requires a genuinely new uniform arithmetic classification.
residual_risks: No arbitrary recurrence coefficient Q, no uniform effective error term in prime counting, and no finite computation as a substitute for Dirichlet arithmetic.

limitations: The statement assumes P>=3, recurrence constant +1 and fixed parameter P; the classical P=1 case is prior work, and the P=2 special case is excluded.
Unindexed general Lucas literature and the 2016 first-kind valuation primary full text remain explicit priority risks; not certification of historical independence.
